name: Droplet vitrification of sweet potato axillary meristems (20 min LS, 30 min PVS2 on ice, aluminium foil strip plunged into liquid nitrogen, held in 2 mL cryotubes of LN)
plain_name: Preserve sweet potato varieties by flash-freezing tiny shoot tips on foil strips
description: Clonal-crop genebank method (KU Leuven / Bioversity International): 1 mm3 axillary meristems are loaded for 20 min, dehydrated 30 min in PVS2 in an ice bath, placed in droplets on a 4 x 15 mm aluminium foil strip, plunged into liquid nitrogen and kept for at least 30 min in a 2 mL cryotube filled with liquid nitrogen before rewarming in recovery solution at room temperature; cryopreservation of shoot tips in LN at -196 °C is the FAO-recognised long-term route for vegetatively propagated food crops.
keywords: Preserve sweet potato varieties by flash-freezing tiny shoot tips on foil strips

sources.citation: Wilms H, Fanega Sleziak N, Van der Auweraer M, et al., Panis B (2020). Development of a fast and user-friendly cryopreservation protocol for sweet potato genetic resources. Scientific Reports 10:14674. doi:10.1038/s41598-020-70869-3
FAO (2014). Genebank Standards for Plant Genetic Resources for Food and Agriculture

requirements.rationale: The foil strip is plunged into liquid nitrogen and the meristems are held in a cryotube filled with liquid nitrogen.
Cryopreserved plant shoot tips are held at the liquid-nitrogen temperature, -196 °C (77.15 K).
The carrier (foil strip) is immersed directly in liquid nitrogen; supporting flag only.
